body:
My name is Yolanda.  I have been in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit for Five days with my sixteen year old son. He Lived, and died. I was able to bring him home today. My youngest son 8 year old Jake found his brother falling all over the house and stupified at 3:00 a.m. last wednesday night.
The look on both of their faces were to much to bare. 911 Ambulance and four point restraints began our journey.  My son did not go on this trip alone. My 8 year old son, myslef his mother, Tommy, his grandmother, aunts, uncles, and Pediatric ICU staff were all along for the ride. My son had never taken drugs before, and the kid who brought this to his highschool, cliaming that my son could have an American Indian experience, that this drug was used by his poeple. we are native.
the boy 16 year old must have gotten a kick out of almost killing this boy. He is evil. Anyway, my son did not recognize me for days, his eyes wild with both fear and pain, the cathader, the tubes, rectal, ng tubes, the monitors, the blood dried mouth, the pain, the tears, the collapses. why didnt he know who i was, we were best friends? I cried, i collapsed, i laid in the floor, and no one could help.
My son Joseph took about 200-300 seeds. his friend said he would have a vision quest. He was in the ICU for several days, when they inserted the rectal tube, there were so many seeds, that it clogged the tube. He almost died. and as his mom, who loves him more than life itself, wondered if that might give him some peace.
My son.... laying there dying, and not knowing who I was, was unbearable, and again I collapsed with fear and pain. But it was on the third day maybe fourth when he finally recognized me, was when he was saying goodbye to me and asking to promise that I wont be sad, they were waiting for him and that he was dying.
I just got home two hours ago from the ICU unit. Thank God with my child. we beat this Datura, My medicine was stronger than his.
